nodes.characterization_summary: XANES shows Ru valence state of +1.6 in Ru/CoFe-LDHs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the oxidation state and local bonding environment of Ru in Ru/CoFe-LDHs were analyzed by X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) ... the results showed that the valence state of Ru is +1.6

nodes.characterization_summary: FT-EXAFS reflects Ru-O-M (Fe/Co) bonds in Ru/CoFe-LDHs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the local bonding environment of Ru in Ru/CoFe-LDHs were analyzed by ... Fourier-transformed extended X-ray absorption fine structure (FT-EXAFS) spectrum ... as well as the Ru-O-M (Fe/Co) bonds were reflected in Ru/CoFe-LDHs

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms formation of Ru-O-M (Fe/Co) bonds inducing electron transfer from Fe/Co to Ru via bridging O.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XPS result confirmed that the formation of Ru-O-M (Fe/Co) bonds can induce electron transfer from Fe/Co to Ru via bridging O

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando XAS at Ru, Co, and Fe K-edge shows reversible redox change of Ru and irreversible oxidation of Co and Fe during OER in Ru/CoFe-LDHs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Operando XAS recorded interesting valence changes of Ru, Fe, and Co elements during the OER process (Figs. 2(g)-2(i)). During the application of the potential from the open-circuit voltage (OCV) to 1.6 V and then to the OCV, Ru exhibited a reversible redox change, while in contrast, Co and Fe showed irreversible oxidation.
